verses.original: Αὐτὸς δὲ ἐγὼ Παῦλος παρακαλῶ ὑμᾶς διὰ τῆς πραΰτητος καὶ ἐπιεικείας τοῦ Χριστοῦ ὃς κατὰ πρόσωπον μὲν ταπεινὸς ἐν ὑμῖν ἀπὼν δὲ θαρρῶ εἰς ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Autos de egō Paulos parakalō hymas dia tēs prautētos kai epieikeias tou Christou hos kata prosōpon men tapeinos en hymin apōn de tharrō eis hymas
verses.literal: Now by the mildness and gentleness of Christ I appeal . . . to you I Paul who am humble when face to face with you but bold - when away
verses.literalPt: ALÉM disto, eu, Paulo, vos rogo, pela mansidão e benignidade de Cristo, eu que, na verdade, quando presente entre vós, sou humilde, mas ausente, ousado para convosco;

verses.original: δέομαι δὲ τὸ μὴ παρὼν θαρρῆσαι τῇ πεποιθήσει ᾗ λογίζομαι τολμῆσαι ἐπί τινας τοὺς λογιζομένους ἡμᾶς ὡς κατὰ σάρκα περιπατοῦντας
verses.transliteration: deomai de to mē parōn tharrēsai tē pepoithēsei hē logizomai tolmēsai epi tinas tous logizomenous hēmas hōs kata sarka peripatountas
verses.literal: I beg you that when I come I may not need to be as bold . . . as I expect toward those who presume that we live according to the flesh
verses.literalPt: Rogo-vos, pois, que, quando estiver presente, não me veja obrigado a usar com confiança da ousadia que espero ter com alguns, que nos julgam, como se andássemos segundo a carne.

verses.original: Ἐν σαρκὶ γὰρ περιπατοῦντες οὐ κατὰ σάρκα στρατευόμεθα
verses.transliteration: En sarki gar peripatountes ou kata sarka strateuometha
verses.literal: For though we live in the flesh we do not wage war according to the flesh
verses.literalPt: Porque, andando na carne, não militamos segundo a carne.

verses.original: τὰ γὰρ ὅπλα τῆς στρατείας ἡμῶν οὐ σαρκικὰ ἀλλὰ δυνατὰ τῷ Θεῷ πρὸς καθαίρεσιν ὀχυρωμάτων
verses.transliteration: ta gar hopla tēs strateias hēmōn ou sarkika alla dynata tō Theō pros kathairesin ochyrōmatōn
verses.literal: The weapons of our warfare are not the weapons of the flesh Instead they have divine power to demolish strongholds
verses.literalPt: Porque as armas da nossa milícia não são carnais, mas sim poderosas em Deus para destruição das fortalezas;

verses.original: λογισμοὺς καθαιροῦντες καὶ πᾶν ὕψωμα ἐπαιρόμενον κατὰ τῆς γνώσεως τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ αἰχμαλωτίζοντες πᾶν νόημα εἰς τὴν ὑπακοὴν τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: logismous kathairountes kai pan hypsōma epairomenon kata tēs gnōseōs tou Theou kai aichmalōtizontes pan noēma eis tēn hypakoēn tou Christou
verses.literal: We demolish arguments and every presumption set up against the knowledge of God and we take captive every thought to make it obedient to Christ
verses.literalPt: Destruindo os conselhos, e toda a altivez que se levanta contra o conhecimento de Deus, e levando cativo todo o entendimento à obediência de Cristo;

verses.original: καὶ ἐν ἑτοίμῳ ἔχοντες ἐκδικῆσαι πᾶσαν παρακοήν ὅταν πληρωθῇ ὑμῶν ἡ ὑπακοή
verses.transliteration: kai en hetoimō echontes ekdikēsai pasan parakoēn hotan plērōthē hymōn hē hypakoē
verses.literal: And we will be ready to punish every act of disobedience as soon as your obedience is complete
verses.literalPt: E estando prontos para vingar toda a desobediência, quando for cumprida a vossa obediência.

verses.original: Τὰ κατὰ πρόσωπον βλέπετε εἴ τις πέποιθεν ἑαυτῷ Χριστοῦ εἶναι τοῦτο λογιζέσθω πάλιν ἐφ’ ἑαυτοῦ ὅτι καθὼς αὐτὸς Χριστοῦ οὕτως καὶ ἡμεῖς
verses.transliteration: Ta kata prosōpon blepete ei tis pepoithen heautō Christou einai touto logizesthō palin eph’ heautou hoti kathōs autos Christou houtōs kai hēmeis
verses.literal: You are looking at outward appearances If anyone is confident that he belongs to Christ he should remind . . . himself that we belong to Christ just as much as he does
verses.literalPt: Olhais para as coisas segundo a aparência? Se alguém confia de si mesmo que é de Cristo, pense outra vez isto consigo, que, assim como ele é de Cristo, também nós de Cristo somos.

verses.original: ἐάν τε γὰρ περισσότερόν τι καυχήσωμαι περὶ τῆς ἐξουσίας ἡμῶν ἧς ἔδωκεν ὁ Κύριος εἰς οἰκοδομὴν καὶ οὐκ εἰς καθαίρεσιν ὑμῶν οὐκ αἰσχυνθήσομαι
verses.transliteration: ean te gar perissoteron ti kauchēsōmai peri tēs exousias hēmōn hēs edōken ho Kyrios eis oikodomēn kai ouk eis kathairesin hymōn ouk aischynthēsomai
verses.literal: For even if I boast somewhat excessively about the authority the Lord gave us for building you up rather than . . . tearing you down . . . I will not be ashamed
verses.literalPt: Porque, ainda que eu me glorie mais alguma coisa do nosso poder, o qual o SENHOR nos deu para edificação, e não para vossa destruição, não me envergonharei.

verses.original: ἵνα μὴ δόξω ὡς ἂν ἐκφοβεῖν ὑμᾶς διὰ τῶν ἐπιστολῶν
verses.transliteration: hina mē doxō hōs an ekphobein hymas dia tōn epistolōn
verses.literal: I do not want to seem to be . . . trying to frighten you by my letters
verses.literalPt: Para que não pareça como se quisera intimidar-vos por cartas.

verses.original: Ὅτι Αἱ ἐπιστολαὶ μέν φησίν Βαρεῖαι καὶ ἰσχυραί ἡ δὲ παρουσία τοῦ σώματος ἀσθενὴς καὶ ὁ λόγος ἐξουθενημένος
verses.transliteration: Hoti Hai epistolai men phēsin Bareiai kai ischyrai hē de parousia tou sōmatos asthenēs kai ho logos exouthenēmenos
verses.literal: For some say His letters are weighty and forceful but his physical presence is unimpressive and his speaking is of no account
verses.literalPt: Porque as suas cartas, dizem, são graves e fortes, mas a presença do corpo é fraca, e a palavra desprezível.

verses.original: τοῦτο λογιζέσθω ὁ τοιοῦτος ὅτι οἷοί ἐσμεν τῷ λόγῳ δι’ ἐπιστολῶν ἀπόντες τοιοῦτοι καὶ παρόντες τῷ ἔργῳ
verses.transliteration: touto logizesthō ho toioutos hoti hoioi esmen tō logō di’ epistolōn apontes toioutoi kai parontes tō ergō
verses.literal: Such people should consider that what we are in our letters when absent we will be . . . in our actions when present
verses.literalPt: Pense o tal isto, que, quais somos na palavra por cartas, estando ausentes, tais seremos também por obra, estando presentes.

verses.original: Οὐ γὰρ τολμῶμεν ἐνκρῖναι ἢ συνκρῖναι ἑαυτούς τισιν τῶν ἑαυτοὺς συνιστανόντων ἀλλὰ αὐτοὶ ἐν ἑαυτοῖς ἑαυτοὺς μετροῦντες καὶ συνκρίνοντες ἑαυτοὺς ἑαυτοῖς οὐ συνιᾶσιν
verses.transliteration: Ou gar tolmōmen enkrinai ē synkrinai heautous tisin tōn heautous synistanontōn alla autoi en heautois heautous metrountes kai synkrinontes heautous heautois ou syniasin
verses.literal: We do not dare to classify or compare ourselves with some who commend themselves When they measure themselves by themselves and compare themselves with themselves they show their ignorance
verses.literalPt: Porque não ousamos classificar-nos, ou comparar-nos com alguns, que se louvam a si mesmos; mas estes que se medem a si mesmos, e se comparam consigo mesmos, estão sem entendimento.

verses.original: ἡμεῖς δὲ οὐκ εἰς τὰ ἄμετρα καυχησόμεθα ἀλλὰ κατὰ τὸ μέτρον τοῦ κανόνος οὗ ἐμέρισεν ἡμῖν ὁ Θεὸς μέτρου ἐφικέσθαι ἄχρι καὶ ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: hēmeis de ouk eis ta ametra kauchēsometha alla kata to metron tou kanonos hou emerisen hēmin ho Theos metrou ephikesthai achri kai hymōn
verses.literal: We however will not boast beyond our limits but only within the field of influence . . . . . . that God has assigned to us a field that reaches even to you
verses.literalPt: Porém, não nos gloriaremos fora da medida, mas conforme a reta medida que Deus nos deu, para chegarmos até vós;

verses.original: οὐ γὰρ ὡς μὴ ἐφικνούμενοι εἰς ὑμᾶς ὑπερεκτείνομεν ἑαυτούς ἄχρι γὰρ καὶ ὑμῶν ἐφθάσαμεν ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: ou gar hōs mē ephiknoumenoi eis hymas hyperekteinomen heautous achri gar kai hymōn ephthasamen en tō euangeliō tou Christou
verses.literal: We are not overstepping our bounds as if we had not come to you Indeed we were the first to reach . . . you with the gospel of Christ
verses.literalPt: Porque não nos estendemos além do que convém, como se não houvéssemos de chegar até vós, pois já chegamos também até vós no evangelho de Cristo,

verses.original: οὐκ εἰς τὰ ἄμετρα καυχώμενοι ἐν ἀλλοτρίοις κόποις ἐλπίδα δὲ ἔχοντες αὐξανομένης τῆς πίστεως ὑμῶν ἐν ὑμῖν μεγαλυνθῆναι κατὰ τὸν κανόνα ἡμῶν εἰς περισσείαν
verses.transliteration: ouk eis ta ametra kauchōmenoi en allotriois kopois elpida de echontes auxanomenēs tēs pisteōs hymōn en hymin megalynthēnai kata ton kanona hēmōn eis perisseian
verses.literal: Neither do we boast beyond our limits in the labors of others But we hope that as your faith increases our area of influence among you will greatly increase as well . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Não nos gloriando fora da medida nos trabalhos alheios; antes tendo esperança de que, crescendo a vossa fé, seremos abundantemente engrandecidos entre vós, conforme a nossa regra,

verses.original: εἰς τὰ ὑπερέκεινα ὑμῶν εὐαγγελίσασθαι οὐκ ἐν ἀλλοτρίῳ κανόνι εἰς τὰ ἕτοιμα καυχήσασθαι
verses.transliteration: eis ta hyperekeina hymōn euangelisasthai ouk en allotriō kanoni eis ta hetoima kauchēsasthai
verses.literal: so that we can preach the gospel in the regions beyond you Then we will not be boasting in the work already done in another man’s territory
verses.literalPt: Para anunciar o evangelho nos lugares que estão além de vós e não em campo de outrem, para não nos gloriarmos no que estava já preparado.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ καυχώμενος ἐν Κυρίῳ καυχάσθω
verses.transliteration: Ho de kauchōmenos en Kyriō kauchasthō
verses.literal: Rather Let him who boasts boast in the Lord
verses.literalPt: Aquele, porém, que se gloria, glorie-se no SENHOR.

verses.original: οὐ γὰρ ὁ ἑαυτὸν συνιστάνων ἐκεῖνός ἐστιν δόκιμος ἀλλὰ ὃν ὁ Κύριος συνίστησιν
verses.transliteration: ou gar ho heauton synistanōn ekeinos estin dokimos alla hon ho Kyrios synistēsin
verses.literal: For it is not the one who commends himself who is approved but the one whom the Lord commends
verses.literalPt: Porque não é aprovado quem a si mesmo se louva, mas, sim, aquele a quem o Senhor louva.
